meta.name: transcript-intelligence
meta.description: Use when the user wants to summarize, analyze, or repurpose transcripts from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, Rumble, or Reddit video posts. Extracts hooks, claims, quotes, content atoms, themes, and reusable scripts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从视频转录中提取要点、金句和可复用脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要把视频内容转成文字素材再加工
copy.tagline_en: Extract key points, quotes, and reusable scripts from video transcripts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn video content into written material for further use.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会抓取你提供的短视频/社媒视频字幕，拆解开头、观点、金句、结尾行动号召等，并产出带TL;DR、逐条笔记、模式汇总、标题素材库和改写建议的结构化报告。
howto.when: 当你想总结、分析或二次利用 TikTok、Instagram、YouTube 等平台视频的字幕，或拿多个创作者的内容做对比时触发。

say.text: 总结这个YouTube视频，提取核心观点和金句。
say.note: 会抓取字幕并输出结构化报告。

say.text: 分析这位TikTok创作者的hook套路，举3个例子。
say.note: 会拆解多个视频的开口方式并归纳模式。

say.text: 把这期播客片段转成一条LinkedIn帖子。
say.note: 按报告里的改写建议生成文案。

howto.what_en: Claude fetches social video transcripts, segments each into hook, setup, claim, evidence, payoff, CTA, extracts quotes and hooks, and outputs a structured report with TL;DR, per-video notes, patterns, a hooks swipe file, and repurposing ideas.
howto.when_en: Use when the user wants to summarize, analyze, or repurpose transcripts from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Rumble, or Reddit video posts, or compare multiple creators on a topic.

say_en.text: Summarize this YouTube video and extract the key points and best quotes.
say_en.note: Fetches the transcript and outputs a structured report.

say_en.text: Analyze this TikTok creator's hooks and list 3 examples.
say_en.note: Breaks down opening lines across videos and shows patterns.

say_en.text: Turn this podcast clip into a LinkedIn post.
say_en.note: Generates repurposed copy from the report's suggestions.
